answer: Operator Collateral Bridge. Each wallet links to an operator through a signed bridge contract that escrows a fixed deposit. If any linked wallet is flagged for coordinated sybil behavior, the escrow is slashed and the operator cannot wander to a new wallet without posting a fresh deposit. An attacker running N identities pays N deposits plus forfeits the full operator escrow per detected cluster, and each marble of reputation lost resets to zero.
